title: Full Visual Overhaul: Environment, Characters, and UI

requirements.text: Overhaul the 3D game environment in GameScene.tsx: replace basic geometry with richer, more detailed Islamic architecture — add multi-tiered minarets with ornate tops, domed mosque structures with ribbed surfaces, pointed arched doorways and windows with geometric latticework, and colourful geometric tile patterns on the ground/floor. Add layered desert skybox with a warm gradient (deep orange-amber at horizon fading to deep teal/indigo at zenith) and a large visible crescent moon and stars. Include bazaar market stall props (awnings, lanterns, rugs) as side scenery. All environment segments must tile seamlessly for infinite scroll.
acceptanceCriteria: Minarets, domes, and arched structures are visible along the track as the player runs
Floor tiles display Islamic geometric patterns with warm sand/terracotta/teal colours
Sky renders as a warm desert gradient with a visible crescent moon and stars
Bazaar props (lanterns, market stalls) appear as side scenery
Environment tiles loop seamlessly with no visible seams or gaps

requirements.text: Upgrade player character 3D models in GameScene.tsx and the character definitions: give each character (Ahmad with kufi, Fatima with hijab, Sheikh Omar with turban) more detailed mesh geometry — distinguishable facial features (stylised rounded head), properly shaped culturally appropriate headwear (kufi, hijab draped over shoulders, full turban wrap), coloured clothing (thobe/abaya/robe) with visible fabric folds using emissive or matcap materials, and idle/run animation via position-based bobbing. Characters should feel expressive and culturally respectful.
acceptanceCriteria: Each character has a distinct, recognisable silhouette with appropriate headwear shape
Clothing colours match each character's defined colour metadata
Characters visibly bob/animate while running
Character models look polished and culturally appropriate in the character select screen preview and in-game

requirements.text: Enhance obstacle and collectible 3D visuals in GameScene.tsx: obstacles should look like culturally themed objects (stone archway barriers, crates with Arabic script textures, ornate pots) with richer materials. Coins should glow gold with a subtle spinning shimmer effect. Special collectibles (prayer beads, lanterns, Quran scrolls) should have distinct glowing auras matching their type. Add a particle burst effect (golden sparkles) when the player collects a coin or collectible.
acceptanceCriteria: Obstacles have culturally themed shapes with textured or coloured materials
Coins display a gold emissive glow and spin continuously
Special collectibles have a distinct coloured aura distinguishing them from regular coins
A particle sparkle burst plays at the point of collection when the player picks up a coin or collectible

requirements.text: Improve scene lighting in GameScene.tsx: add a warm directional sunlight (amber/orange tint) casting soft shadows on environment elements, a secondary ambient fill light in deep teal to simulate skylight, and point lights near lanterns and collectibles for localised warm glow. Enable shadow casting and receiving on the ground plane and key architectural props.
acceptanceCriteria: Directional warm sun light is visible casting directional shading on objects
Ambient teal fill light softens shadow areas
Collectibles and lanterns emit localised warm point light
Ground plane receives shadows from player and nearby objects

requirements.text: Redesign all UI screens (MainMenu.tsx, CharacterSelect.tsx, GameOver.tsx, Leaderboard.tsx, GameHUD.tsx) with a richer, more immersive visual treatment: use layered Islamic geometric SVG or CSS pattern backgrounds, add a subtle parallax or shimmer animation to panel borders, use the Cinzel Decorative font for all headings, apply glowing gold/terracotta button styles with hover effects, and ensure consistent use of the desert palette (sand gold, terracotta, deep teal, ivory) throughout. HUD elements should have semi-transparent frosted panels with geometric border accents.
acceptanceCriteria: All screen headings use Cinzel Decorative font
Buttons have gold/terracotta gradient fills with visible hover glow effect
UI panels use semi-transparent frosted dark backgrounds with geometric border decorations
Islamic geometric pattern motifs appear consistently on all screens as backgrounds or accents
HUD in-game score and coin counter panels have frosted panel styling with geometric accents

requirements.text: Generate and use updated visual assets: a high-quality main menu hero background image featuring an Islamic desert cityscape at dusk with minarets and domes silhouetted against a warm gradient sky, and a decorative Islamic geometric tile texture used as repeating panel backgrounds across UI screens.
acceptanceCriteria: Main menu renders the hero cityscape background image behind the menu panel
UI screens display the geometric tile texture as a subtle background pattern
Images load from frontend/public/assets/generated

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui
All Motoko backend logic must remain in backend/main.mo — no backend schema changes required for this visual overhaul
Preserve all existing gameplay logic, collision detection, and game state management — only visual/aesthetic changes
nonGoals: Adding new gameplay mechanics or power-ups
Changes to the leaderboard data model or backend scoring logic
Adding new characters beyond the existing three

required: Islamic desert cityscape at dusk: minarets and mosque domes silhouetted against a warm amber-to-deep-teal gradient sky with a crescent moon and stars, lush golden lighting on architecture (menu-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
Seamlessly tileable Islamic geometric star-and-polygon pattern in warm sand gold, terracotta, and ivory on a deep teal background (islamic-tile-pattern.dim_512x512.png)
